description: This file defines a generic class 'PagedRequest' used for encapsulating pagination and sorting parameters in data requests within the Fineract project. It supports conversion to Spring Data's 'PageRequest' to facilitate pagination features.

classes.name: PagedRequest
classes.description: A generic class for managing pagination and sorting parameters for data queries.

classes.name: SortOrder
classes.description: A nested static class representing a sorting order with direction and property.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns an Optional wrapping the request object if present.

methods.name: toPageable
methods.description: Converts the page, size, and sort parameters into a Spring Data PageRequest object for pagination.

methods.name: toOrder
methods.description: Converts the SortOrder instance into a Spring Data Sort.Order object.
